# Citewise

> Citewise (working name) tracks whether AI engines such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Claude recommend and cite a brand, drafts pages that close the gaps, and answers the visitors those engines send with an AI support agent. Early build, October 2026.

## Pages

- [Home](/): what Citewise does and the build status
- [Free AI audit](/audit): checks whether AI crawlers can read a site (engine ships in week 2)
- [Build blueprint](/blueprint): architecture, data model, pipelines, pricing and the 8-week plan
- [Botric system design](/system-design): an independent teardown of how botric.ai is built

## Concepts

- Visibility Score: 0-100, built from mention rate (40%), rank (20%), citations of your own domain (25%) and tone (15%)
- Prompt outcomes: named and cited, named only, cited only, or not mentioned
